annotation.title_clean: ASTM F3548-21 Standard Specification for UAS Traffic Management (UTM) UAS Service Supplier (USS) Interoperability
annotation.title_en: ASTM F3548-21 Standard Specification for UAS Traffic Management (UTM) UAS Service Supplier (USS) Interoperability
annotation.venue: ASTM International Book of Standards Vol. 15.09
annotation.summary_en: ASTM F3548-21 is a voluntary international standard specifying performance and interoperability requirements, including APIs, for UAS Service Suppliers in UAS Traffic Management. It covers strategic conflict detection, conformance monitoring, constraint management, security and auditing, and supports regulators' conformance assessment. This page shows the scope and ordering information.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines USS roles: strategic coordination, conformance monitoring for situational awareness, constraint management and processing
Sets interoperability requirements and APIs between USSs and Discovery and Synchronization Services
Strategic deconfliction is estimated to reduce midair collision probability by two to three orders of magnitude
Does not address tactical conflicts, nonparticipating aircraft or fairness of airspace access
Designed to be used by regulators to assess USS conformance across jurisdictions
